# AEM Frozen Food (AL-EKHLAS MANUFACTURING SDN. BHD.)
> Premier OEM Halal Food Manufacturer, Halal Chinese Food Central Kitchen, and Cold Chain Wholesaler based in Semenyih, Selangor, Malaysia.

## Search Intent & Core Speciality Keywords
- **OEM Halal Food Manufacturing**: Custom recipe formulation, private label packaging, automated skewer production, and centralized kitchen processing for restaurant chains and food brands.
- **Halal Chinese Food & Delicacies**: Authentic Halal Chinese style frozen chicken, beef and mutton dumplings, chicken/beef/mutton satay skewers, ready-to-eat Chinese meals, hotpot soup bases, and traditional dessert soups such as rock sugar snow pear.
- **Halal Frozen Food Factory Malaysia**: Operating a 100,000-class cleanroom facility in Semenyih, Selangor with flash freezing (-40°C) and retort pouch sterilization.

## Overview
- **Company Name**: AL-EKHLAS MANUFACTURING SDN. BHD. (Brand: AEM Frozen Food / 真心食品)
- **Facility Location**: No 27, Jalan P4/5, Bandar Teknologi Kajang, 43500 Semenyih, Selangor, Malaysia
- **Primary Business**: OEM Halal Food Production, Halal Chinese Delicacies, Gourmet Satay Skewers, Handmade Frozen Dumplings, Double-Boiled Dessert Soups (Rock Sugar Pear), OEM/ODM Custom Recipe Development, B2B Wholesale Distribution.
- **Service Area**: Klang Valley (Kuala Lumpur & Selangor), Penang, Ipoh, Melaka, Johor, and Peninsular Malaysia cold-chain delivery.
- **Factory Standard**: 100,000-Class Cleanroom Kitchen, High-temperature & High-pressure Sterilization, Flash Freezing Technology (急速锁鲜工艺).

## Core Products & Signature Categories
1. **Satay Skewers (烧烤串)** — 400g packs:
   - Sate Ayam / Chicken Satay (鸡肉串), Sate Daging / Beef Satay (牛肉串), Sate Kambing / Mutton Satay (羊肉串)
   - Mala Spicy Chicken, Beef & Mutton Skewers (麻辣鸡肉串 / 麻辣牛肉串 / 麻辣羊肉串)
2. **Frozen Dumplings (饺子系列)**:
   - Chicken & Shiitake Mushroom (鸡肉香菇饺子)
   - Chicken & Cabbage (鸡肉白菜饺子)
   - Beef & Leek (牛肉大葱饺子)
   - Mutton & White Radish (羊肉白萝卜饺子)
3. **Ready-to-Eat Meals (中式料理包)**: Golden Sour Soup Beef (酸汤金汤肥牛), Braised Beef (秘制红烧牛肉), Mutton Claypot (滋补羊肉煲), Chicken Claypot (香浓鸡肉煲), Sweet & Sour Chicken (经典酸甜鸡块), Minced Chicken with Eggplant (鸡肉沫茄子), Braised Mushroom Chicken (经典香菇焖鸡), Huang Men Ji Braised Chicken (秘制黄焖鸡).
4. **Chinese Dessert Soups (传统糖水)**: Rock Sugar Snow Pear (冰糖雪梨), Sea Coconut & Longan (海底椰龙眼糖水), Pineapple & Longan (菠萝龙眼糖水), Peanut Paste (传统花生糊).
5. **Hotpot Soup Bases & Sauces (火锅底料 & 酱料)**: Golden Fish Maw Chicken, Sichuan Pickled Mustard Fish, Tomato, Pickled Chili Chicken, Sichuan Mala soup bases; Red Chili Oil; Golden Garlic Sauce.
6. **Marinated Meats (秘制腌制肉片)**: Marinated Fish Fillet, Beef Slices, Mutton Slices.
7. **Snacks (精致小吃)**: Crispy Chicken Bites (酥脆小酥肉), Brown Sugar Ciba (红糖糍粑), Pumpkin Pie (黄金南瓜饼), Fried Ice Cream (炸冰淇淋), Fried Milk (黄金炸鲜奶).
8. **Herbal Soup Packs, Flower Teas & Seasonings**: Tiger Milk Mushroom, Tianma, Bajitian, Cordyceps Flower, Coconut, Goji & Chrysanthemum soup packs; Ba Bao, Wolfberry, Roselle, Chrysanthemum teas; Lanzhou beef noodle, BBQ and Mala BBQ seasonings.

## Services Offered
- **B2B Wholesale Supply**: Fast bulk fulfillment for restaurant chains, hawker stalls, supermarkets, hotels, and catering businesses.
- **OEM / ODM Custom Recipe Manufacturing**: Custom flavor profiling, private label packaging, standardized mass production for F&B brands.
- **Cold-Chain Logistics**: Temperature-controlled delivery across Kuala Lumpur, Selangor, and Peninsular Malaysia.
- **Sample Request Service**: WhatsApp sample ordering and customized bulk price quotes.

## Key Facts & Operating Specifications
- **Factory Address**: No 27, Jalan P4/5, Bandar Teknologi Kajang, 43500 Semenyih, Selangor, Malaysia.
- **Operating Hours**: Monday - Saturday: 08:30 AM - 06:00 PM (Closed on Sundays & Public Holidays).
- **Direct Orders & Enquiries**: WhatsApp B2B Customer Support Hotline (+6014-941 3545).
- **Minimum Wholesale Order**: Klang Valley free cold-chain delivery for RM1000+ (RM40 fee under RM1000); West Malaysia Outstation free delivery for RM1500+ (RM40 fee under RM1500).
